main_text.p: de juft. & jur. Alex. consil. 109. libr. 1. & consil. 119. libr. 7. n. 15. wissenb. disput. 3. Pand. num. 13. Si tamen commodè & citra periculum quis fugere possit, etiam fugere tenebitur. Gilhauf. Arbor. crim. cap. 2. tit. n. 26. Quò etiam facere videtur constit. Carol. crim. art. 140. Uti id vuit[?] Gilhauf. loc. cit. vid. tamen Speckhan. cent. 3. class. 2. quaest. 7.

Neque hîc distinguo inter nobilem & ignobilem; quasi illi semper & in omni occasione fuga sit ignominiosa, huic non item. Textus enim generaliter & indistinctè loquuntur. §. 2. Inst. ad l. Aquil. l. 4. l. 45. §. 4. D. eod. Cumque defensio sit juris naturæ, quod inter nobiles & ignobiles discrimen non ponit, omnium par erit ratio. Init. Inst. de libert. l. 3. D. Just. & Jur. l. 2. & 3. Cod. Ad l Corn.

page.notes: The first paragraph's opening line is italic and runs from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". "Si tamen" is read with a small gap, printed as "Sitamen" in the scan. "vuit" is printed that way and may be a misprint for "vult"; it is marked [?]. The last line "l Corn." is right-aligned and ends the paragraph, so it is not a catchword. No catchword or signature is printed.
